clips.title: The story
paras: Mist's Edge is the long, windswept coastline stretching north from Auberdine along western Darkshore. Shrouded in damp ocean fog, these gray beaches are littered with shipwrecks, colossal sea creature remains, and roving packs of crabs and murlocs.

Running along the western edge of Darkshore, Mist's Edge is defined by damp sands, rocky tidepools, and perpetual coastal fog. The beach is a graveyard of the sea, littered with decaying sea behemoths, drift timber, and the shattered ribs of wrecked vessels. While seemingly barren, the coastline teems with shoreline scavengers, notably aggressive crabs and territorial murloc tribes that nest in the surf.
